newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal economy authorities narrow figures gap.
newsitem.headline: Portugal economy authorities narrow figures gap.

text.p: Portugal's National Statistics Institute (INE) and the Bank of Portugal have narrowed differences in how they calculate economic output, removing a confusing variation in statistics, officials said.

The latest figures for gross domestic product (GDP) for full-year 1996, issued by INE on Friday, calculated output at 16.53 trillion escudos, only some 86 billion more than the Finance Ministry, which uses the Bank of Portugal numbers.
In the past, the difference had been as wide as 500 billion.
According to INE officials, the Institute had revised its figures in a number of areas, particularly housing.
